notes.title: Verified coverage and limits · Greenwich fee research
notes.body: Research performed 6 November 2026. Public data includes the dated May 2017 secondary archive (per credit hour) and official Fall 2026–27 standard tariffs (per course). Current named programmes use the university-wide degree-level rate with the mapping disclosed in each record; these are not programme-specific invoices. Indexed 2020 schedules are drafts because their original URLs now redirect. Do not compare per-credit and per-course amounts, infer programme availability in earlier years, or fabricate missing annual observations. 2026 full-calendar CPI is unavailable before year end; real values stay unavailable without compatible verified CPI. Undated fee pages, third-party estimates and University of Greenwich UK records were excluded.
